title: Ham and Yukon Gold Potato Soup
description: Tender potatoes thicken a milky ham soup seasoned with mustard and thyme.

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
steps.text: Dice {ham} and peeled {potato} into ½-inch pieces.

steps.title: Set up the pot
steps.text: Use the enamel Dutch oven on a medium burner; adjust the flame to hold a bare simmer.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Melt {butter}; stir in {garlic}, {thyme} and {ap} over medium heat for 90 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Whisk in {broth}, add the potatoes and simmer covered 15–20 minutes until easily crushed. Mash one-third against the side of the pot.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in {ham}, {milk} and {mustard}. Heat gently for 5–8 minutes to 165°F without scorching.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers within 2 hours and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes, freeze in meal-size containers for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: stir over medium-low heat to 165°F, adding a splash of water as needed. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat to 165°F. Dairy swap: replace each dairy ingredient with unsweetened oat milk or an equivalent dairy-free butter or cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 258 kcal, 18.3 g protein, 34.8 g total carbohydrate, 5.4 g fat, 2.2 g fiber, 486 mg sodium.
